items.title: Percy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: After the duets at the Lincoln Center with Jeb Patton

ctx.x: Final question, will there ever be a Percy Heath album? You’ve never recorded as a leader, and at this stage of the game, I think that’s a fair question.

I don’t know about a Percy Heath album. Those Heath Brothers’ albums are a collaboration. I have about ten compositions of mine. Maybe, one day. After the duets at the Lincoln Center with Jeb Patton, did you go to those?
I was out of town. I heard they were good though.
